# Rasmus Bremholm

> Fullstack developer based in Göteborg, Sweden, specializing in Next.js, React, and SEO-focused web development.

Rasmus is a fullstack developer and educator with 9 years of experience (6 teaching), currently working at Tetiko. Background spans e-commerce, education, and 3D art, with particular expertise in Next.js, Sanity, and technical SEO.
